programme.title: And God Said to Cain
programme.desc: After ten years in prison for a crime he didn’t commit, ex-Confederate officer Gary Hamilton returns to seek revenge on Acombar, the man who framed him and stole both his gold and his lover. Surrounded by enemies, Hamilton uses the town’s secret tunnels to strike back in a stormy, haunting showdown.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father’s death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: Payment in Blood
programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: Winnetou and the Crossbreed
programme.desc: On her 21st birthday, Apanatschi inherits her father’s secret gold mine. When greedy prospectors discover its existence, they plot to seize it by targeting her family. Forced to seek Winnetou’s help, Apanatschi soon finds herself caught in a dangerous struggle involving outlaws, betrayal, and hidden treasure.

programme.title: Trinity in Eldorado
programme.desc: Con artists Jonathan and Sebastian roam the West seeking easy riches. When magic elixirs and card tricks fail, they target the eccentric Eldorado. Recruiting Ringo Jones and enlisting Eldorado’s niece Juanita, they plot the heist - but with so much at stake, can trust survive among them?

programme.title: Renegade Gunfighter
programme.desc: After witnessing his parents’ murder by a ruthless gang, a young man dedicates his life to becoming the fastest gun in the West. Years later, he returns to his hometown, armed with deadly skill and a thirst for vengeance, determined to face the killers who destroyed his family and reclaim his peace.

programme.title: Run, Man, Run
programme.desc: Several competing groups and mavericks (including the lead character Cuchillo) are hunting a gold treasure of $3,000,000. The gold was reserved for the Mexican revolution.

programme.title: Two Brothers in Trinity
programme.desc: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble. Will they ever fulfil their dreams?

programme.title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
programme.desc: When bandits begin kidnapping Clayton City’s elite for ransom, Sartana is called in to restore order. But the gang’s mysterious leader sees him as a deadly threat and hires four expert killers to take him down. To save the town and expose the mastermind, Sartana must survive every trap and betrayal.

programme.title: Professionals for a Massacre
programme.desc: During the Civil War, three outlaws face execution for selling guns to the enemy — until a Confederate general spares them. Their mission: recover a hidden fortune in gold under the watch of an officer. But rival treasure hunters turn their path to freedom into a deadly race.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django is on the trail of some renegade outlaws who raped and killed his wife. En route, he rescues a horse thief from an impromptu hanging. He discovers the man knows who committed the murder. The men team up and head west for revenge.

programme.title: Day After Tomorrow
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Stan Ross arrives in Canyon City, drawn by a bank robbery. Hired by the town’s powerful banker Jefferson, he hunts down a gang of Mexican bandits - only to uncover shocking secrets. As Ross digs deeper, he realizes Jefferson’s grip on the town is far more dangerous than he thought.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: Sartana and Trinity set out on a grudging relationship hell bent for gold and comic brawls.
